We've boarded the turbocycle. Where would you like to go?
Gillian! I have a videophone call from Jamie! I'll connect you..
What good will it do to go back to your apartment?
We've already requested that the Neo Kobe Police protect Katrina.
We should get to Queens Hospital quickly!
Let's head to Queens Hospital.
What's wrong? Aren't you going to go and search for Katrina?
Katrina is not here. Let's look elsewhere.
If we waste too much time, the SNATCHERS will get there first! We must hurry!
There is nothing left to do here. Let's move on!
What are you doing? We need to determine whose patient record this is as quickly as possible.
Let's hurry back to headquarters!
We've arrived at headquarters. What would you like to do?
We've arrived at your house. What would you like to do?
We've arrived at Jean Jack Gibson's house. What would you like to do?
We've arrived at Alton Plaza. What would you like to do?
We've arrived at Oleen Hospital. What would you like to do?
We've arrived at Queens Hospital. What would you like to do?
We've arrived at Outer Heaven. What would you like to do?
All right. Now heading for Junker Headquarters.
Why don't we stop by my apartment?
Good idea. That fortune teller's comment has been bothering me...
Good idea. It might be worthwhile to search the neighborhood.
Let's go, Metal!
Understood. Setting course for your apartment...
All right, now heading for your apartment.
What good will it do to go to your apartment at a time like this? We have to find Katrina as quickly as possible!
Gillian! You have to look for Katrina first! We can visit your apartment later.
All right, now heading for your apartment.
Get us to Gibson's house, now Metal! Set the automatic traffic control system to give us absolute priority!
God, I hope she's safe...
All right, now heading for Jean Jack Gibson's house.
All right, now heading for Alton Plaza.
All right, now heading for Hospital Oleen.
Okay, let's get out to Queens Hospital!
This is it!
All right, now heading for Queens Hospital.
All right, now heading for Outer Heaven.
Gillian! Where are you going? Katrina is in danger!
Gillian! We have to get to Gibson's house quickly!
Where are you going? We should hurry to Queens Hospital.
Why don't we check out Queens Hospital first?
Gillian! We have to hurry back to Headquarters!
Gillian, what's wrong? Are you trying to flee?
All right, let's use the videophone.
What number should I dial?
They're not home. We should head for Alton Plaza quickly ourselves.
There's no answer. Apparently no one is there.
We probably shouldn't get involved any further with them.
Gillian, we don't have any reason to go to Plato's Cavern, do we?
Metal, could you give me Jamie's videophone number again?
Sure. It's 39-3444.
The number of the lab where she works is 39-1009.
At this time of day, I suppose she's at work.
What was Napoleon's videophone number?
Please Gillian, you really should have it memorized by now.
Remember it as 39-5644, okay?
What was the number on those tissues we got at Alton Plaza?
That would be 55-6666.
What was the number I got for answering that quiz question correctly?
What was the number on those tissues we found at Alton Plaza?
What was Isabella's videophone number?
What's the number for the old guy we met by Ivan's house?
What? You again? What do you want, more information?
That's right. I need your help.
Why don't we get the password out of the way first...
What? You again?
Sorry. You'd prefer a woman, I suppose?
Whatever. Anyway, how about giving me the password?
The revolution...
The 100 day...
Please input using the cursor.
What? That's totally wrong!
You haven't input anything at all!
Nice try, but no cigar!
You're guessing are'nt you?
You're so close, it's almost sad!
You need to work on your verb tenses a bit.
Way off the mark, son!
You haven't input anything at all!
I don't know anything about that.
I think you should go back to school, you need some spelling lessons!
Did you forget how to spell when you lost your memory?
Never heard of that.
Did you forget how to spell when you lost your memory?
Did you forget how to spell when you lost your memory?
Did you forget how to spell when you lost your memory?
Stop fantasizing!
Stop fantasizing!
All right, you pass! But we can't talk on the videophone. I'll meet you in the usual place.
Don't blow-off your appointment this time, either. Come right away!
I'll be seeing you. Look me up again after you've done your homework!
Have you forgotten it, Gillian?
The hundred days reign, right?
You're really forgetful...
Have you forgotten it, Gillian?
The revolution is ended, right?
You're really forgetful...
What? Don't you know?
He hung up...what are you going to do?
That's funny, I'm sure I got the phone number right.
Perhaps the SNATCHERS have killed Napoleon, too!
This isn't right! Where could he have gotten off to?
Besides, Napoleon should be able to read the code on that patient record that we found.
Huh? What's this symbol?
It looks vaguely familiar...
Where in the world has Napoleon gone?
What? It's that symbol again. What is this? This isn't anything of JT&T's.
Gillian, I know where Napoleon is. Have you figured it out? Let's hurry up and head there.
It's a code telling where he is! Let's hurry and head there!
I don't have the slightest idea what you're talking about.
Gillian! A wolfman! We've seen this wolfman before, right!
The wolfman is the hint! We've met him elsewhere before, right?
You know, the wolfman! The one we saw at that place that serves buffalo...
My god! A SNATCHER!
I guess she's at the lab.
Jamie is probably at the lab now.
Oh, that's right.
She is at the lab. That is what she said on the videophone, right?
At the lab again, eh?
She is quite busy.
She is at the lab now. Why don't you try contacting her there?
She really had me for a moment there! Since when did she start pulling practical jokes like this?
Well, you did show her your mask the other day.
What, the one I use to get into Outer Heaven? Even so, that last joke wasn't very funny.
No doubt that message is a strategy of hers to deal with your troublesome calling.
Just what is that supposed to mean, Metal?
There's no need to be embarrassed, Gillian. I'm fully aware that Jamie has "snatched" your heart.
Sorry about that. I mean, being on duty and all...
Gillian, please ask Jamie for her assistance.
Yeah, yeah... we need to know if she has any ideas about black market hospitals, right?
It was nice talking to you Jamie. Bye for now...
If I find anything out about the hospital, I'll give you a call.
Thanks. I really need your help on this one.
See you later, Gillian. Bye!
Talk to you later Gillian. Bye!
What's wrong, Gillian? Didn't you have something you wanted to talk about?
Jamie, I can't see you very well from here!
Well, I'm glad you called, but don't get carried away, all right?
Jamie?
What's the problem Gillian? C'mon, cheer up! Don't worry! Be happy!
It's been a while since we met, hasn't it, Jamie.
Yeah. It's been since before you became a Junker, hasn't it.
What was it you said that night? I couldn't hear you over the noise of the turbocycle's engine.
Oh, nothing.
Jamie, you're always so pretty.
Oh Gillian, you've been saying that since they found us in Siberia.
Siberia... We do have a shared past after all, don't we. It's a little short, but...
Jamie, you really look good in white.
You think so?
You're looking really good, Jamie.
I'm doing all right.
Jamie, we may not have any memories of our life together, but we can make them from here on out.
Yes, but Gillian...
Why are we always so worried about some lost past? Let's build a bright future together!
My heart knows that, but in my head... I just can't make up my mind.
So is that? Are we finished?
If we separate now, it will be painless Gillian. We don't have to hurt each other.
Jamie, this is something I've learned since we split up.
Although my memories of our time together aren't coming back, my feelings of our time together never left...
Gillian...
My feelings for you are still strong. Actually I think I'm beginning to fall in love with you all over again.
And in a way that has nothing to do with our lost past.
Thanks, Gillian. You're probably right. We can't keep looking back over our shoulders forever.
It was short, but our time together was wonderful.
Yes but we could never stop arguing.
Yeah, but even those memories are precious now.
Our only memory together...
I was really worried at first about becoming a Junker.
Of course, Gillian. People like us who have lost their memories never know at first what they're cut out for.
I feel like I can really find myself through this job.
I know what you mean. You get surprised by your own actions... You feel like you can see your inner self, right?
It all feels like fate somehow. Me and the Junker agency... and me and those SNATCHERS.
Well, it can't all be unrelated. If it was, why would we have been called to Neo Kobe like this?
But I wonder how long this can last...
Chasing them down...
Probably at least until our memories return.
Jamie, I've learned that the SNATCHERS have taken over a hospital somewhere on the island. I need your help in investigating this.
All you have to do is ask, Gillian. I'll do anything to help out.
I'll see what I can do on this end. It may take me a while, though.
Ask me anything. I may be able to help you out.
Jamie, that message on your answering machine... Wasn't that going a bit too far?
Did I scare ya'?
You bet you did!
Were you worried?
Yes, I was worried.
How worried?
How worried? Well, really worried, you know...
Good...
Would you cut the jokes like that... If the SNATCHERS ever actually got their hands on you, I'd...
I don't even want to think about it as a joke.
Okay, Gillian.
Still, that mask was really well done.
Well, after you showed me your mask for Outer Heaven...
What? Was that made at Plato's Cavern?
Yeah. I borrowed it from a guy at work.
No wonder. They make really good stuff over there.
Jamie? I'm sorry about that little stunt I pulled the other day.
Oh... that?
I heard from the Chief.
Oh really...
Why didn't you tell me?
I don't know... I really don't.
I'm sorry. It was really immature of me.
I just got really upset...
Gillian?
Yes?
You're the only one for me. I'm always thinking about you.
Don't forget it, okay?
Thanks Jamie.
Jamie, the other day I asked you if you had been to Alton Plaza, right?
Yes.
And you said you had never been there...
That's right.
Don't lie to me...
Jamie, as a matter of fact, I...
...what?
I saw you Jamie. I saw you walking with the Chief.
Was that some kind of mistake?
...you saw us..
Hmm?
It must have been somebody else.
Somebody else?
Can't we talk about something a little more positive?
Dodging the issue, eh? Sounds like an admission of guilt to me.
Hey! Stop trying to play detective with my personal life!
Can I ask you one question?
What?
Do you remember the picture of you that I have?
Yes, that picture of me when I was a little girl, right?
Where was that taken?
I don't really know... It looks like the Olympics or something.
I wonder how long you've had that.
I suppose I had it with me when the army picked us up.
Hmmm. That picture looks like it might have been taken at the Moscow Olympics.
Moscow? When was that?
A long time ago. Long before we were born.
And that's all you wanted to ask about it?
You see, Jamie, the picture looks like it may have been faked.
Faked? Who would do something like that? And why?
I don't know. But they may be using us as their guinea pigs.
What are you talking about?
It's as if we're being controlled by something we cannot see.
Only us? Hmmm. We're the only ones who don't even know about ourselves.
Maybe the government knows something.
Oh, let's just forget this Gillian. Let's just be ourselves.
Let's worry about what to do from now on.
How's your memory doing? Any sign it might be coming back?
I seem to remember wearing white... Can't you recall anything Gillian?
Jamie in white. Hmmm. I'm afraid not. Nothing.
What about your memory therapy?
I'm still going.
Any progress?
No change yet.
Oh... okay.
Sometimes, when I'm not even trying, I get these really vague images, but when I try to recall anything more, they vanish.
I guess we're just going to have to let time do its work.
The SNATCHERS require a hospital which has facilities to treat ultraviolet ray exposure. Do you have any ideas about that?
Well, having facilities to treat ultraviolet ray exposure is nothing rare. But we keep records here on the hospitals on the island. I'll take a look at those.
But don't get your hopes up. If it's a black market place running on its own, we probably won't have anything at all on it.
If I learn anything, I'll give you a call.
Don't worry. If I figure anything out, I'll give you a call.
Now I've got a reason to talk to you again sometime.
You silly. You don't have to have a reason to talk to me.
You know, I...
No...I'm sorry.
Oleen Hospital? Oh, that's right! That's that veterinary clinic, isn't it? They're totally legit. Rather stuffy operation though. They only treat purebreds and official genetic manipulants.
I really doubt they have anything to do with SNATCHERS.
Ah! Here it is! They placed a large order for anti-cancer drugs from between October and December.
Anti-cancer drugs, huh? I knew it!
Well, that settles that.
The director is Chinese, named Chin Shu Oh.
Hmmm. Chin Shu Oh...
Wow, it looks like they were ordering truckloads of the stuff, too. I'd be careful, Gillian.
Our records aren't all that detailed, though. That's all I can tell you.
I wonder who this Chin Shu Oh is?
I've never heard the name before. We have nothing on him in here either. He might be one of those unlicensed underground doctors.
How about your Junker data?
Yeah, we checked him out. He's had quite a career.
He's had his license suspended, right? There's a lot of those underground doctors here in the city.
Why don't you check your Junker records. You might have something on him.
I'll take a look at our data here, too.
Thanks, that'll be a big help.
Jamie, are you still having that dream?
Yes. Almost every day now.
It must have some meaning. What does your counselor say?
He says that it means I'm refusing or rejecting something.
I'm scared, Gillian. Maybe I'm better off not getting my memory back.
Jamie?
Maybe it's better for us, too, keeping things the way they are now.
No way! I'll never settle for keeping things like this.
Gillian, are we really married?
What's that supposed to mean?
Maybe we are really enemies or something...
Oh relax, Jamie, that's a silly idea...
I really care about you, Gillian, but those feelings aren't some gate into the past...
I feel the same way.
Then why don't we just keep things the way they are?
Okay, okay. Let's just take it naturally. Not try to force anything.
But I don't want to have that dream again tonight. It's so painful.
It's not just you, Jamie. It's me, too.
Thanks, Gillian.
Thanks for asking me to dinner the other day.
Thanks for asking me to the musical the other day.
Thanks for asking me to the zoo the other day.
Thanks for asking me to the amusement park the other day.
Thanks for asking me to go to the beach with you the other day.
Thanks for asking me to the races the other day.
Thanks for asking me to go out with you the other day.
Thanks for asking me to the arcade the other day.
Thanks for asking me to the aquarium the other day.
I'm sorry I couldn't go, but I was really happy that you asked.
If we don't get together now, we may never have another chance.
Please don't say things like that. This is hard on me, too.
Jamie, I don't want to talk to you over the videophone like this. Let's meet and talk face-to-face.
Gillian, I'm always thinking about you. But I don't know if we should see each other right now.
We'll just run into the same old problems.
Jamie, I'd really like to see you. When can we meet?
Seeing you would just bring more pain, Gillian. Let's leave it at that.
I want to see you...
I can't see you now, Gillian. We're better off like this.
So that's your Junker ID, eh? It's kinda fancy looking.
Fancy? This thing? Whatever you say.
That's really nice. Now you finally have something to identify yourself with.
Oh Gillian, I'm not having any money problems now. I've got a good job. Don't worry about me.
So they actually pay you? That's a relief...
That is your expense money which is...
Metal! You shut up!
Ye..Yessir!
That's a chess piece. What's that for?
I still haven't figured that out myself.
Is that supposed to have some meaning?
From what I know of Gibson's personality, it probably does.
I found this at that hospital I was telling you about.
I found this at Queens Hospital, the place the SNATCHERS are probably using as their maintenance facility. Any ideas?
Do you know what it is?
Looks like part of a patient's chart, but that's Chinese, right? Those underground doctors sometimes use code to protect themselves from prying eyes. Maybe that's what this is.
Chinese? Wait! That's right! Napoleon is Chinese! He should be able to read this!
These five characters should be the patient's name. Why don't you ask somebody who knows Chinese to help you.
We should ask Napoleon.
Gillian, do you smoke?
No, I need this for my investigation.
I see. After all, hardly anybody smokes anymore...
Gillian, you know smoking's bad for your health. Don't even think about doing it, okay?
Don't worry. I'm always chewing a piece of gum anyway.
They give it to me at the agency. It's got adrenaline in it.
Oh, so it was "Queens," eh?
Oleen. Hmmm. I think I've heard of that. I think it might be a hospital on the island.
Almost all of the development and administration of pharmaceuticals on the island takes place here.
I'm sorry. I'm not really sure if there is any such hospital.
A palace, eh? I wonder where it is?
It looks like a palace. I've never seen anything like that here. It must be far away.
There is no answer. Apparently no one is home.
The call will not go through.
It seems that the line is busy.
